findings.reason: §4's own dispatchable text must name cache_reuse_summary.served_keys as the owner to extend (and drop both file counts at cache_guard.py:213 and prewarm.sh:135), or the reconciliation stays in a comment a worker need not read.
findings.text: §4's section text ("make the guard's served_entries count program-key cache entries") specifies a second program-key counter inside the guard while the key enumeration already lives in cache_reuse_summary.served_keys:63; the correction to extend that owner exists only in an appended _top owner comment (2026-10-06T023247151541), so a worker dispatched on §4 — the plan's only implementable section — would fork the counter it was told to reconcile

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds no new module of its own; §3's already-committed operator_request_body hides six request kinds behind one body, and the §4 work extends one existing key reader rather than spreading new wrappers over the lane machinery.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4, the plan's only implementable section, still directs the program-key count at the guard's own served_entries (scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py:209) rather than naming the owner served_keys in scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_reuse_summary.py:63 that its own owner note reconciles onto.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; no section adds to any of these families (the work is benchmark scripts and tests), so nothing needs to name a retirement or merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan's live sections cite the mechanisms they extend through its 2026-10-06 owner notes: the executable-size gate as benchmarks/solve_program_size_gate.py (fed by benchmarks/program_scope_census.py), the committed request machine as OperatorRequestKind/operator_request_body in nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:923,972, and the pre-warm key reader as served_keys in scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_reuse_summary.py:63 with the row machinery in prewarm_row.py/publish_prewarm_pin.py; §1-§3 are declared deferred and superseded by converged-forward-solve.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section proposes a thin layer over existing machinery; §4 changes the guard, the pre-warm and the summary to read through one existing key set, which is an extension of the owners rather than a parallel wrapper.
